description: AGSC-07-12: the Harness directory name is a function of the MEMBER SET and of nothing else. Derivation, by hand: the verdict's selection[] is the surviving set in code-point order (AGSC-07-09), so the input order b, a gives ["a","b"]; its JCS form (AGSC-04-05) is the 9-byte string ["a","b"] with no whitespace; the SHA-256 of those 9 bytes is 0473ef2dc0d324ab659d3580c1134e9d812035905c4781fdd6d529b0c6860e13, and <name> is its first sixteen lowercase-hex characters, 0473ef2dc0d324ab. The digest is the selection digest the emitted files carry under AGSC-07-16. No path, clock or host reaches the name, which is what makes AGSC-07-13 attainable in a browser that has no path; compose --out chooses where the files land and reaches no emitted byte.
